form.title: What grows on the field?
form.description: Choose the crop and the day for which we check water on the field.
form.dateHint: Today by default. You can choose any day from {min}.

dateErrors.future: We cannot check a future day. Choose today or an earlier day.
dateErrors.tooOld: We look back at most 10 years. Choose a day from {min}.

form.submitHint: The result usually takes a few seconds.

mode.legend: How should the {count} parcels be analysed?
mode.togetherHint: One assessment for the whole area – when the parcels form one field with the same crop.
mode.separateHint: An assessment for each parcel and the order in which to start. Takes longer – we compute two at a time.

form.dayLegend: Which day should we calculate for?

progress.title: Checking water on the field
progress.hint: Fetching data from several sources at once. This usually takes a few seconds.
progress.slow: One of the sources is slower than usual ({seconds} s). Still waiting – up to a minute.

sources.parcel: parcel boundaries and land use from the register (GUGiK)
sources.weather: 10 years of weather and the forecast

error.title: We could not prepare the report
error.timeout: The analysis took longer than a minute, so we stopped waiting. One of the data sources is not responding – try again in a moment.

messages.upstream_failed: One of the data sources (e.g. GUGiK or the weather service) did not respond. This is usually temporary – try again in a moment.
messages.not_found: We could not find this parcel in the land register. Check the parcel number or pick it on the map.
messages.validation_failed: The link is missing data or the day is outside the analysis range (last 10 years). Choose the crop and day again.
